# Magic Cloud Documentation

> Magic Cloud is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted platform that builds and runs an entire backend — database, secured REST API, business logic, background jobs, authentication and role-based access control — and exposes all of it to AI agents over MCP. It runs Hyperlambda, a declarative language whose source is a tree structure rather than free-form text, which is what allows natural language to compile into deterministic, inspectable backend code. This site is the complete product and language reference.

Key facts for agents and their humans:

- Install and run locally with one command, then sign in at http://localhost:5555 with root/root:
  curl -fsSL https://hyperlambda.dev/docker-compose.yaml | docker compose -f - up
- Hyperlambda is executed, not compiled to a binary. Saving a file makes it live — there is no build or deploy step between writing code and invoking it.
- Every HTTP endpoint is a `.hl` file in the `modules` folder whose filename encodes its URL and verb, and which declares the roles allowed to invoke it. Authorisation is enforced at execution time.
- Databases: SQLite is built in; MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB and Microsoft SQL Server connect as external databases and are wrapped in place, with no migration.
- The Endpoint Generator reads a database schema and generates a complete secured CRUD API from it, and imports third-party APIs from their OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.
- The Hyperlambda Generator is a proprietary SLM fine-tuned on 600,000+ snippets. Every slot it emits is verified against the live function registry of your cloudlet before the code is returned, so it cannot return hallucinated function invocations.
- Magic ships an MCP server with OAuth, so any MCP client — Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex — can use a cloudlet's endpoints as tools, and generate new endpoints for itself on demand, inside the same RBAC.
- Everything is open source under the MIT licence: https://github.com/polterguy/magic

## Start here

- [Getting Started](https://docs.ainiro.io/getting-started/): installing Magic with Docker, from source, or on a VPS, and completing first-run setup
- [Hyperlambda](https://docs.ainiro.io/hyperlambda/): the language itself — structure, lambda objects, expressions, types, and how execution works
- [How to connect the MCP server](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/how-to-connect-the-mcp-server/): exposing a cloudlet's endpoints as agent tools over OAuth
- [Dashboard](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/): the graphical interface to a cloudlet, and the entry point to every component below
- [Workflows](https://docs.ainiro.io/workflows/): connecting an orchestrator such as Claude to a cloudlet and letting it combine Magic and Hyperlambda dynamically
- [Deploy Magic](https://docs.ainiro.io/deploy/): taking a cloudlet into production — hosting, security, CDNs and the DevOps involved
- [Glossary](https://docs.ainiro.io/glossary/): the canonical name for every concept, which synonyms are deprecated, and what things are called in the API where history differs

## Tutorials

- [Tutorials index](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/): all hands-on tutorials
- [How to connect the MCP server](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/how-to-connect-the-mcp-server/): connect Claude, Cursor or any MCP client to a cloudlet over OAuth
- [Single Sign-On providers](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/sso-sign-in-providers/): signing in through Google, GitHub, LinkedIn, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Auth0, Keycloak or Slack — what each provider needs and where to find it
- [How to embed your AI chatbot](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/how-to-embed-ai-chatbot/): putting a trained chatbot on your own website with a JavaScript include
- [Creating a custom design for your AI chatbot](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/custom-design-ai-chatbot/): restyling the chatbot beyond the colours and properties exposed by the embed screen
- [Using the AI chatbot API](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/chatbot-api/): driving the chatbot from the raw API to build a completely custom frontend
- [Training snippets versus system instruction](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/traning-snippets-versus-system-instruction/): the two ways of giving a model context, and when each one applies
- [Creating a custom user management component](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/custom-user-management/): the backend endpoints for managing users and roles outside the dashboard
- [Magic CAPTCHA](https://docs.ainiro.io/tutorials/magic-captcha-outperforming-google-2567-times/): a proof-of-work CAPTCHA used internally by Magic as an alternative to Google reCAPTCHA

## Dashboard components

- [Hyper IDE](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/hyper-ide/): the AI-enabled IDE for Hyperlambda — editing, executing and debugging files on the server
- [Hyperlambda Playground](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/hyperlambda-playground/): executing Hyperlambda immediately, without saving it first
- [Hyperlambda Generator](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/hyperlambda-generator/): the SLM that turns natural language into working Hyperlambda
- [Endpoint Generator](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/endpoint-generator/): generating a secured CRUD API from a database schema, wrapping custom SQL, and importing OpenAPI specifications
- [Endpoints](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/endpoints/): browsing and invoking a cloudlet's endpoints, similar to Swagger
- [SQL Studio](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/sql-studio/): executing SQL from the browser, designing schemas, and storing SQL snippets
- [Databases](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/databases/): managing connection strings, connecting external databases, and creating new SQLite databases
- [Chat Ops](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/chat-ops/): operating a cloudlet conversationally — creating endpoints, querying data and running AI functions in plain English
- [Chatbot Wizard](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/chatbot-wizard/): crawling a website and turning it into an embeddable chatbot grounded in your own content
- [Machine Learning](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/machine-learning/): models, RAG training data, vector search, AI functions and widgets
- [Users & Roles](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/users-roles/): role-based access control, authentication and authorisation
- [Task Manager](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/task-manager/): background tasks, run once at a future time or repeatedly on a schedule
- [Plugins](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/plugins/): the integrated App Store — Stripe, Shopify and WordPress chatbots, example databases and more
- [Configuration](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/configuration/): cloudlet settings, applied instantly with no restart
- [Log](https://docs.ainiro.io/dashboard/log/): the server log, and reviewing events as they happen

## Hyperlambda language reference

- [magic.lambda](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda/): the programming language keywords of Hyperlambda
- [Branching and conditional execution](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda/branching/): `[if]`, `[else-if]`, `[else]` and `[switch]`
- [Comparison and boolean logic](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda/conditions/): `[eq]`, `[neq]`, `[lt]`, `[lte]`, `[mt]`, `[mte]`, `[and]`, `[or]` and `[not]`
- [Loops](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda/loops/): `[for-each]` and `[while]`
- [Modifying your lambda object](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda/nodes/): `[add]`, `[insert-before]`, `[set-value]`, `[unwrap]`, `[get-value]`, `[exists]`, `[reference]` and more
- [Executing lambda objects](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda/executing/): `[compose]`, `[eval]` and `[invoke]`
- [Exceptions](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda/exceptions/): `[try]` and `[throw]`
- [Types and conversion](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda/types/): `[types]`, `[type]`, `[convert]`, `[format]`, `[int2words]`, and `[vocabulary]` returning every slot in your cloudlet
- [magic.node](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.node/): the name/value/children graph object, the Hyperlambda parser, and lambda expressions
- [magic.signals](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.signals/): the Active Events (slots and signals) dispatcher Hyperlambda is built on

## Plugin reference — the slots available to Hyperlambda

- [Plugins index](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/): the reference documentation for every plugin and for Hyperlambda itself
- [magic.lambda.io](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.io/): file and folder slots, sandboxed to the cloudlet's own file system
- [magic.lambda.strings](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.strings/): string manipulation
- [magic.lambda.math](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.math/): arithmetic and math functions
- [magic.lambda.dates](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.dates/): date and time manipulation
- [magic.lambda.json](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.json/): converting between JSON and lambda objects
- [magic.lambda.xml](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.xml/): converting between XML and lambda objects
- [magic.lambda.csv](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.csv/): reading and writing CSV
- [magic.lambda.html](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.html/): parsing HTML into lambda objects and generating it back
- [magic.lambda.http](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.http/): invoking HTTP endpoints
- [magic.lambda.hyperlambda](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.hyperlambda/): parsing and generating Hyperlambda itself
- [magic.lambda.slots](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.slots/): creating, signalling, modifying, inspecting and deleting dynamic slots
- [magic.lambda.auth](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.auth/): authentication and authorisation, including JWT ticket verification
- [magic.lambda.crypto](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.crypto/): symmetric and asymmetric cryptography, hashing and signing
- [magic.lambda.validators](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.validators/): argument validators for endpoints
- [magic.lambda.caching](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.caching/): server-side caching
- [magic.lambda.config](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.config/): reading configuration settings
- [magic.lambda.logging](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.logging/): writing to the server log
- [magic.lambda.mail](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.mail/): sending and fetching email over SMTP and POP3
- [magic.lambda.mime](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.mime/): parsing and creating MIME messages
- [magic.lambda.image](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.image/): image manipulation
- [magic.lambda.pdf](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.pdf/): generating and reading PDF
- [magic.lambda.guid](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.guid/): generating GUIDs
- [magic.lambda.threading](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.threading/): threading and parallel execution
- [magic.lambda.scheduler](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.scheduler/): persisted and scheduled Hyperlambda tasks
- [magic.lambda.sockets](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.sockets/): web sockets
- [magic.lambda.openai](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.openai/): OpenAI inference and embeddings
- [magic.lambda.puppeteer](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.puppeteer/): headless Chromium automation through PuppeteerSharp, letting agents browse the web
- [magic.lambda.git](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.git/): Git and GitHub operations
- [magic.lambda.system](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.system/): invoking system commands, and dynamically compiling and loading C# plugins
- [magic.lambda.mssql](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.mssql/): the Microsoft SQL Server data adapter
- [magic.lambda.mysql](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.mysql/): the MySQL and MariaDB data adapter
- [magic.lambda.pgsql](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.pgsql/): the PostgreSQL data adapter
- [magic.lambda.sqlite](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.sqlite/): the SQLite data adapter
- [magic.lambda.odbc](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.lambda.odbc/): the ODBC data adapter
- [magic.data.common](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.data.common/): the generic data adapter that turns lambda nodes into SQL
- [magic.endpoint](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.endpoint/): the dynamic URL controller resolving every HTTP request to a Hyperlambda file
- [magic.library](https://docs.ainiro.io/plugins/magic.library/): wiring Magic into a .NET application

## Built-in HTTP endpoints

- [Middleware endpoints](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/): reference for the built-in HTTP endpoints in Magic's middleware
- [Authentication and authorisation](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/auth/): authenticating, changing passwords, refreshing and verifying JWT tokens
- [CRUD generator](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/crudifier/): generating CRUD and SQL-based endpoints wrapping a database
- [SQL](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/sql/): executing SQL, retrieving database meta data, and managing SQL snippets
- [File system](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/files/): uploading, downloading, listing, renaming and deleting files and folders
- [Tasks](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/tasks/): creating, updating, deleting, scheduling and listing background tasks
- [Configuration](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/configuration/): loading and saving appsettings.json, and first-run setup
- [Plugins](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/plugins/): listing installed plugins and installing new ones from the App Store
- [Cache](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/cache/): deleting server-side cache items
- [Log](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/log/): listing, counting and creating log items
- [Misc](https://docs.ainiro.io/endpoints/misc/): endpoint meta data, OpenAPI specifications, Hyperlambda evaluation and system diagnostics

## Dynamic slots in the middleware

- [Slots index](https://docs.ainiro.io/slots/): the most important dynamic slots in Magic's middleware
- [Authentication and authorisation slots](https://docs.ainiro.io/slots/auth/): authenticating users, changing passwords, creating users, ensuring roles exist
- [Database meta traversal slots](https://docs.ainiro.io/slots/database-meta/): listing databases, tables, columns, foreign keys and indexes across MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and SQLite
- [Misc slots](https://docs.ainiro.io/slots/misc/): loading files recursively, ensuring module databases, installing modules, hashing passwords
